mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_upload (user_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, related_type, related_id, ai_parse_result, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{aiParseResult}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM file_upload WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM file_upload WHERE related_type = #{relatedType} AND related_id = #{relatedId}
